zh: 锚点 · 预览图上点空白加锚点、长按拖动调位置
en: Anchors · Tap empty area to add, long-press to drag

zh: 时间单位为秒：9分30秒 填 570
先让桥接器进入配网模式（紫灯闪烁），再扫描连接。
en: Put the bridge into setup mode (purple LED blinking), then scan to connect.

zh: 还没有记录桥接器 IP，先到主界面连一次，或直接按 BOOT 键进配网。
en: No bridge IP saved yet. Connect once from the main screen, or press BOOT to enter setup mode.

zh: 已重置，桥接器正在重启进入配网模式（约 5 秒后紫灯闪烁），稍后点「扫描桥接器」。
en: Reset complete. Bridge is restarting into setup mode (purple LED blinks in ~5s). Tap Scan Bridge shortly.

zh: 重置失败：连不上桥接器 {host}，确认它在线（同一 WiFi）。
en: Reset failed: cannot reach bridge {host}. Verify it is online and on the same WiFi.

zh: 🔄 重置桥接器 WiFi（换 WiFi 用）
未找到桥接器，确认它紫灯闪烁（配网模式）且手机蓝牙已开
en: Bridge not found. Ensure purple LED is blinking (setup mode) and phone Bluetooth is on.

zh: 请先扫描并选择一个设备
en: Scan and select a device first

zh: WiFi 名不能为空，密码至少 8 位
en: WiFi name is required; password must be at least 8 characters

zh: 已发送，桥接器正在连接 {ssid}…
配网成功！桥接器 IP：{host}（已自动记录，返回后可直接连接）
en: Setup complete! Bridge IP: {host} (saved automatically — just connect on return)

zh: 已发送，但未自动发现桥接器。等它连上 WiFi 后，到主界面手动填 IP。
en: Sent, but bridge was not auto-discovered. Wait for it to join WiFi, then enter the IP manually on the main screen.

zh: 配网失败，请重试（确认桥接器在配网模式）
en: Setup failed. Please retry (ensure bridge is in setup mode).

zh: 点击「不同意」将无法继续使用本应用
en: Tapping Decline will exit the app

zh: 需要同意《隐私政策》才能使用本应用。确定退出吗？
en: You must accept the Privacy Policy to use this app. Exit anyway?

zh: 还没有烘焙记录\n连接温控器烘一炉试试
烘豆进行期间的常驻提醒
已进行 {minutes} 分钟 · 曲线记录中
手动：你控制 SV（设定温度），±5 按钮随时手调火力，传统用法。
en: Manual: you control SV (set temperature). Use ±5 to adjust heat on the fly — the classic approach.

zh: 跟随曲线：自动模式，每 2 秒按模板覆盖 SV，温控器自己跟着目标曲线跑。
en: Follow Profile: automatic mode. SV is updated every 2 seconds according to the profile, and the controller tracks the target curve.

zh: 跟随时 SV 是「只读」的，控制器持续覆盖它。
en: SV is read-only while following — the controller continuously overwrites it.

zh: ±5 按钮在跟随时只有一个作用：一键接管——按下即退出跟随、切回手动。
en: During follow, the ±5 buttons have one purpose only: take over — press to exit follow and switch back to manual.

zh: 未连接：只能看设置和历史，没有开始/停止按钮。
en: Not connected: settings and history only — no Start/Stop buttons.

zh: 已连接 · 待命：实时豆温照常显示，但不画曲线、不走计时。
en: Connected · Standby: live bean temperature is displayed, but no curve is drawn and timer is paused.

zh: 已连接 · 记录中：曲线绘制、计时走动。
en: Connected · Recording: curve is being drawn and timer is running.

zh: 「开始」= 连上后手动起表；「停止」= 断开并把曲线定稿保存。开启「入豆自动开始跟随」则投豆瞬间点「入豆」隐式起表。
en: Start = begin recording manually after connecting; Stop = disconnect and finalize the curve. With Auto-follow on Charge enabled, tapping Charge at drop-in implicitly starts recording.

zh: 信号强度：连接后顶部显示彩色圆点 + dBm 值（绿强/黄中/橙弱/红极弱）。烘前若为橙/红，先调整桥接器位置或天线再开烘，避免中途掉线。
en: Signal strength: a colored dot + dBm value is shown at the top after connecting (green=strong, yellow=fair, orange=weak, red=very weak). If orange or red before roasting, reposition the bridge or antenna first to avoid mid-roast disconnection.

zh: 给温控器和 Wi-Fi 转 RS485 设备通电，打开 App 连接（可在设置开启自动连接）。需预热时用 ±5 把 SV 设到预热温度。
en: Power on the temperature controller and Wi-Fi-to-RS485 gateway, then connect in the app (auto-connect available in Settings). Use ±5 to set SV to preheat temperature if needed.

zh: 投豆瞬间点「入豆」：清空预热段、计时归零、记录入豆时刻豆温。若在待命态，入豆会自动开始正式记录。
en: Tap Charge when beans drop in: clears the preheat segment, resets the timer, and logs bean temperature at charge. If in standby, Charge automatically starts formal recording.

zh: 点「跟随曲线」→ 选一炉（仅选中不立刻跟随）。入豆时若开着「入豆自动开始跟随」则自动进入跟随。图表上米灰虚线=目标曲线，橙色实线=实际豆温。
en: Tap Follow Profile → select a roast (selecting does not start following immediately). If Auto-follow on Charge is enabled, following starts automatically at charge. On the chart, light gray dashed line = target curve; solid orange line = actual bean temperature.

zh: 点事件标记即可，全程不用碰 SV：黄点（转黄）、一爆、一爆止。阶段卡自动算脱水/美拉德/发展三段时长与占比。
en: Just tap event markers — no need to touch SV: Yellowing, First Crack Start, First Crack End. The phase card automatically calculates Drying / Maillard / Development durations and ratios.

zh: 点「出豆」：SV 自动降到 25°C 进入冷却并立即存快照。冷却完成后点「停止」最终定稿。
en: Tap Drop: SV automatically drops to 25°C for cooling and a snapshot is saved immediately. Tap Stop after cooling to finalize.

zh: 连接期间每 30 秒自动存草稿。
en: Auto-draft saved every 30 seconds while connected.

zh: 点「出豆」立即存一版快照。
en: Tapping Drop saves an instant snapshot.

zh: 同一炉所有保存都是同一条记录的覆盖更新。App 崩溃或意外断连最多丢最近 30 秒数据；进程被杀后重开会自动恢复未完成的会话。
en: All saves for the same roast overwrite the same record. An app crash or unexpected disconnection loses at most 30 seconds of data; unfinished sessions are automatically restored on relaunch.

zh: 方式一：从历史记录提取
记录 → 选一炉满意的记录 → 右上角「存为模板」。该炉曲线（出豆处截断）即成为可回放模板。
en: Records → pick a roast you like → Save as Profile (top-right). The curve of that roast (truncated at Drop) becomes a replayable profile.

zh: 方式二：导入 Artisan 曲线
监控页 →「跟随曲线」→「导入」→ 选择 Artisan 导出的 .alog 文件。自动解析豆温曲线，若文件自带 computed 事件（入豆/脱水/一爆/出豆的时间与温度）会直接读取为锚点。
en: Monitor → Follow Profile → Import → select an .alog file exported from Artisan. The bean temperature curve is parsed automatically; if the file contains computed events (charge / dry / first crack / drop times and temps), they are imported directly as anchor points.

zh: 方式三：自定义锚点绘制
「+ 新建自定义模板」，点空白加锚点、长按拖动调位置，列表里可精确改时间/温度。
en: + New Custom Profile: tap empty area to add anchors, long-press to drag, and edit time/temperature precisely in the list.

zh: 入豆瞬间若已选模板，自动进入跟随模式
en: With a profile selected, Charge triggers auto-follow

zh: 打开 App 自动连上次的桥接器 IP
en: Auto-connect to last bridge IP on app launch

zh: 事件条增加二爆/二爆止两键，意式深烘用
en: Adds Second Crack Start / End buttons for dark / espresso roasts
Green beans dropped in; timer starts

zh: 豆色转黄，脱水阶段结束
en: Beans turn yellow; drying phase ends

zh: 第一声爆裂，发展期开始
en: First audible crack; development phase begins

zh: 第二爆结束（深度烘焙极限区）
en: Second crack ends (deep dark roast boundary)

zh: 空载测试：空锅跟随带豆模板，BT 会升得比模板快、偏高，属正常物理差异。
en: Empty-roaster test: when following a loaded profile with an empty drum, BT will rise faster and higher than the profile — this is normal physics.

zh: 总线上单主站：接自制桥接器时原 Wi-Fi 转 RS485 设备需断电，两个主站不能同时说话。
en: Single-master bus: power off the original Wi-Fi-to-RS485 gateway when using a DIY bridge — two masters cannot share the same bus.

zh: SV 上限 260°C：适配特殊豆种，超出会被硬限幅。
en: SV upper limit is 260°C (for special beans); values above are hard-clipped.

zh: 返回键：浮层页面（记录/详情/设置/手册）按返回=关闭浮层；烘焙会话进行中返回键被屏蔽防误触退出。
en: Back button: on overlay pages (records / details / settings / manual), Back closes the overlay. During an active roast session, the Back button is disabled to prevent accidental exit.

zh: 失重率：典型 12%~18%，超出 8%~25% 区间会提示复查克重。
en: Weight loss: typically 12–18%. Values outside 8–25% trigger a weight review prompt.

zh: 本项目（App + ESP32 固件）以 Apache License 2.0 开源，源码见 GitHub 仓库。
en: This project (App + ESP32 firmware) is open-sourced under Apache License 2.0. Source code is available on GitHub.

zh: 桥接器持续无响应：可能已被其他程序占用，或设备刚重启尚未就绪
en: Bridge unresponsive: may be in use by another program, or the device is still booting up

zh: 已导入模板：{nm}（{size} 点，含 {size} 个事件锚点）
已导入模板：{nm}（{size} 点）；脱水/一爆等锚点可在编辑器中补充标注
en: Profile imported: {nm} ({size} pts). Add drying / first crack and other anchors in the editor.

zh: 连接不上桥接器：请确认设备已上电、手机与它在同一 WiFi（多次重试均失败）
en: Cannot reach bridge: check power and ensure the phone is on the same WiFi (multiple retries failed).

zh: 模板曲线已走完，已切回手动
en: Profile curve finished — switched back to manual

zh: 偏差超过 15°C 持续 30 秒，已自动切回手动
en: Deviation exceeded 15°C for 30s — auto-switched back to manual

zh: 检测到上次未完成的烘焙会话，已恢复；请重新连接设备继续
en: Previous unfinished roast session detected and restored. Reconnect the device to continue.

zh: 未选模板：点「跟随曲线」选择一炉历史记录作为目标
en: No profile selected: tap Follow Profile to pick a historical roast as target

zh: 将从 .alog 文件读取温度曲线，生成可跟随的模板。
en: Reads the temperature curve from an .alog file to create a followable profile.

zh: · 温度曲线（时间 + 豆温）\n· 入豆 / 出豆 时间锚点
若 .alog 自带 computed 事件（入豆/脱水/一爆/出豆的时间与温度），导入时直接读取为锚点；缺失时回退为温度阈值推导。
en: If the .alog file has computed events (charge / dry / FCs / drop times and temps), they are imported as anchors. If absent, it falls back to temperature-threshold inference.

zh: 还没有模板。可点「+ 新建自定义模板」「导入 Artisan 曲线」，或到历史详情页「存为模板」。
en: No profiles yet. Tap + New Custom Profile, Import Artisan Curve, or go to a roast detail and Save as Profile.

zh: 未读到豆袋生豆批次。请确认：
en: No green bean batches found in BeanBag. Please verify:

zh: · 豆袋已安装且为 3.0.13 或以上版本\n· 豆袋里有生豆批次记录
选批次扣生豆，同时按熟豆名入库熟豆（同名累加）。重复推送不会重复扣/入。
en: Select a batch to deduct green beans and add roasted beans by name (merged if same name). Repeat pushes are idempotent.

zh: 熟豆名称（同名累加库存）
en: Roasted bean name (stock merges by name)

zh: 熟豆克重（出豆重，入库量）
en: Roasted bean weight (drop weight, stock added)

zh: \n⚠ 熟豆入库失败：{message}（可用历史页补录）
en: \n⚠ Roasted add failed: {message} (backfill from history page)

zh: 已入豆，未选模板，当前手动模式；可点「跟随曲线」选择模板开始自动跟随
en: Charged without a profile — manual mode. Tap Follow Profile to select one and start auto-follow.

zh: 豆子名称（如：耶加雪菲 水洗）
⚠ 失重率超出常见区间（8%~25%），确认克重是否输错
en: ⚠ Weight loss outside typical range (8–25%). Check weight entries.

zh: 把本炉补录到豆袋：扣生豆/入熟豆。已同步过的炉会幂等跳过，重复点不会重复入账
en: Backfill this roast to BeanBag: deduct green / add roasted. Already-synced roasts are skipped — safe to tap repeatedly.

zh: 未读到豆袋生豆批次（需豆袋 3.0.14+）
请选择生豆批次并填克重
en: Select a green batch and enter weight

zh: 备份全部记录、模板与设置。「存到下载目录」生成 .zip；「导出到文件」分享 .json。导入时两种格式通用，按 ID 合并（同 ID 覆盖、不删除现有数据）
en: Backs up all records, profiles, and settings. Save to Downloads creates a .zip; Export to File shares a .json. Both formats can be imported and are merged by ID (same-ID overwrites; existing data is never deleted).

zh: 已调起分享：{size} 条记录 / {size} 个模板
此系统不支持直存，请用「导出到文件」分享保存
en: Direct save is not supported on this system. Use Export to File to share and save.

zh: 存到下载目录（同局域网迁移推荐）
en: Save to Downloads (recommended for same-network migration)

zh: 将合并导入 {size} 条记录、{size} 个模板
。同 ID 覆盖、现有数据保留。
en: . Same-ID overwrites; existing data is preserved.

zh: ✅ 导入完成：{size} 条记录 / {size} 个模板
点「入豆」时若已选模板，自动进入跟随曲线模式
en: With a profile selected, tapping Charge auto-starts Follow Profile mode

zh: SV 提前参考 N 秒后的目标值，补偿炉子热惯性（0=关闭）
en: SV references the target value N seconds ahead to compensate for roaster thermal inertia (0 = off)

zh: 启动应用后自动连接上次的桥接器 IP
en: Auto-connect to the last bridge IP on app launch

zh: 给桥接器设置 WiFi（无需电脑），配网模式下手机蓝牙直连
en: Set up WiFi on the bridge via Bluetooth — no computer needed

zh: 底部事件条增加 二爆/二爆止，意式深烘用
en: Adds Second Crack Start / End buttons to the bottom bar — for dark / espresso roasts

zh: 提示：建议烘焙前先在监控页选好模板（选模板不会立刻开始跟随），投豆瞬间点「入豆」即自动跟随。
en: Tip: pick a profile on the monitor screen before roasting (selecting does not start following immediately). Tap Charge at drop-in and following starts automatically.

zh: 烤豆永久免费、开源、无广告。如果你觉得它帮到了你，欢迎到爱发电支持。
en: RoastCurve is permanently free, open-source, and ad-free. If it helps you, consider supporting us on Afdian.
🫘 Sister App: BeanBag — Coffee Bean Tracker

zh: 生豆熟豆库存、做一杯扣账、烘焙消耗联动。烘完的豆子它来管。
en: Track green and roasted bean inventory, deduct per brew, and sync with roast consumption. It manages your beans after roasting.

zh: 透传设备持续无响应：可能已被其他程序占用，或设备刚重启尚未就绪
en: Passthrough device unresponsive: may be in use by another program, or the device is still booting up

zh: SV 写入失败（设备无响应）
设置页「语言 / Language」可选择简体中文或 English；点「导入语言包」可从 zip 文件载入社区翻译，导入后点「应用」生效。
en: On the Settings page, Language lets you pick Simplified Chinese or English. Tap Import Language Pack to load a community translation from a zip file, then tap Apply to activate it.

zh: 内置中文为基准语言；英文与语言包缺词时自动回退中文，不影响使用。
en: Built-in Chinese is the base language; missing keys fall back to Chinese, so the app remains usable.

zh: SV 提前参考 N 秒后的目标值，补偿炉子热惯性（0=关闭）
en: SV references the target N seconds ahead to compensate for roaster thermal inertia (0=off)

zh: 自动模式下风速不低于此值，保证豆子翻滚（流化）。过低会积热局部焦化，按设备实测调（7~60%）
en: In auto mode fan never drops below this

zh: 读取豆袋生豆失败：豆袋可能未安装、版本过旧，或被系统限制后台。
en: Failed to read BeanBag green beans: not installed, too old, or restricted from running in background.

zh: 可稍后到历史记录详情页「补录到豆袋」重试，或先在系统设置允许豆袋后台运行。
en: Retry later via Records → detail → Backfill to BeanBag, or allow BeanBag to run in background in system settings.

zh: 选批次并填入豆前称好的生豆克重，扣减生豆库存。熟豆冷却称重后到记录详情页补录（自动算失重率）。
en: Pick a batch and enter the green bean weight measured before charging. After the roast cools and is weighed, backfill the roasted beans from the record detail page (weight loss auto-calculated).

zh: 熟豆待称重：冷却后到历史记录详情页补录入库，将自动计算失重率。
en: Roasted beans pending: weigh after cooling, then backfill from the record detail page — weight loss is auto-calculated.

zh: 熟豆已保存，可补录到豆袋
自定义温控器寄存器与通讯参数
兼容其他品牌 Modbus 温控器；改动后重新连接生效。参数错误会导致读不到温度
en: For third-party Modbus thermostats. Takes effect on reconnect. Wrong values = no temperature

zh: 自定义 PV/SV 寄存器与波特率（兼容其他品牌温控器）
这些参数决定如何与温控器通讯。默认为台泉 TC4S（0x0000/0x0002/1200/从站1），一般不用改。更换其他品牌 Modbus 温控器时，按该品牌手册填。填错会导致读不到温度。
en: These control how the bridge talks to your thermostat. Defaults target Taichuan TC4S (0x0000/0x0002/1200/slave 1); usually no change needed. For other Modbus thermostats, fill per their manual. Wrong values mean no temperature.

zh: PV 寄存器地址（实际温度）
SV 寄存器地址（设定温度）
⚠ 改动需重新连接后生效。寄存器地址填错时温控器会无响应（读不到温度），改回正确值即可。
en: ⚠ Takes effect after reconnect. Wrong register = no response (no temperature).

zh: 一键恢复：PV=0x0000 SV=0x0002 波特率=1200 从站=1。
曲线走完自动将温度/风速降到下面的值（不再停在终点干烧）
file: SV/fan settle to these values (no more idling at the end point).
